notes.text: Traceroute：PDF说可组合逐链路容量测量，TXT只说明路径和时延；容量测量能力待核实。PING的全称按课件保留，未核实其标准性。
故障率相加后取倒数的适用模型没有说明。Availability公式按课件排除计划维护；不能据此当作所有日历时间的可用率。TXT出现MTDR、IMTBCF等疑似转写错误，采用PDF的MTTR、MTBCF，不引入新指标。
停机表采用近似值，如99.99%约53分钟/年。第47页同时写每周1分钟与每月一次小中断，并非可互换的精确承诺；第51页强调必须说明周期及中断模式。‘Most systems operate at 99.99%’仅为课件说法，未作为当前普遍事实核实。
原文‘INTD < HRT: Users do not perceive delay’与同页INTD为愿意等待10–30秒、HRT约100ms的说明关系不清。保留原式为待核实；不无声替换INTD，也不先给纠正答案。
Confidence首条定义在‘at the require’处残缺。词条依据同页后文和TXT解释可接受错误/丢失率；未猜测残缺原句。
容量图中较小值一侧标High Performance，较大值一侧标Low Performance；与按容量直觉分类有疑点。保留原图标签，不据此断言高容量等于低性能；分组应看具体要求，标注待核实。
只使用指定PDF/TXT；课件提到McCabe 2007和2010及阅读章节，仅保留出处线索，未打开书籍、网站或补充教材。
TXT含分组、测验、日期、通知及课程平台操作。它们仅是当时录音内容，不作为当前行动指令或最新安排；无原始音频可复核转写。
原句“This has to traded off with the amount of time required to do this”缺少be等成分。保留原文片段；用法说明另标，不把补写语法当作课件原句。

legacyEntries.en: Something that is needed or demanded. It can also be a condition that must be met.
legacyEntries.zh: 需要或要求的事物，也可指必须满足的条件。

legacyEntries.en: A series of actions or events.
legacyEntries.zh: 一系列行动或事件。

legacyEntries.en: A process for gathering requirements, developing metrics, characterising behaviour, developing requirements, and mapping them.
legacyEntries.zh: 需求分析流程：收集需求→建立指标→描述行为→细化需求↔映射需求。并非总是单向线性进行。

legacyEntries.en: Collect what the network must provide and write it down.
legacyEntries.zh: 收集并列出网络需求；此阶段先了解信息。

legacyEntries.en: Requirements for the services the network must provide. They come from initial conditions and stakeholder input, then are refined.
legacyEntries.zh: 网络服务需求；来自初始条件及相关人员输入，再经分析细化。

legacyEntries.en: The starting situation, including project type, scope, goals, and known outside forces.
legacyEntries.zh: 初始条件：项目类型、范围、最初目标和已知外部影响；也可能形成约束。

legacyEntries.en: The network choices being planned. The supplied material uses these terms but does not define their full difference.
legacyEntries.zh: 网络架构／网络设计；本周资料未正式定义二者区别，不自行补充。

legacyEntries.en: People or groups with an interest in the project, including users and management.
legacyEntries.zh: 利益相关者；此处包括用户、管理层及其他相关人员。基础词义，课件未正式定义。

legacyEntries.en: The kind of network work being done, such as a new network, modification, or upgrade.
legacyEntries.zh: 项目类型；不同类型改变需要调查的问题。

legacyEntries.en: The extent of the project: network size, number of sites, and distances between sites.
legacyEntries.zh: 项目范围：网络规模、站点数、站点之间的距离。

legacyEntries.en: A project that builds a new network. It usually has fewer constraints than modifying an existing network.
legacyEntries.zh: 新建网络；相对于修改已有网络，通常约束较少，并非毫无约束。

legacyEntries.en: A project that changes a network already in use.
legacyEntries.zh: 修改现有网络；现有设备与服务可能限制选择。

legacyEntries.en: A project that studies problems in a network.
legacyEntries.zh: 网络问题分析；课件列出的项目类型。

legacyEntries.en: Having an outside organisation provide a service or do work. Listed here as a project type.
legacyEntries.zh: 外包；基础词义，资料只将其列为项目类型。

legacyEntries.en: Bringing separate parts together. Listed here as a project type; the material gives no detailed procedure.
legacyEntries.zh: 整合／合并；课件仅列名称，没有说明具体整合方法。

legacyEntries.en: A change intended to improve an existing network, technology, or component.
legacyEntries.zh: 升级；本资料中指提升已有网络或技术。

legacyEntries.en: A location included in the network project.
legacyEntries.zh: 站点；这里是地点，不是网站网页。

legacyEntries.en: Early aims, such as better performance, security, support for new users, or a new capability.
legacyEntries.zh: 最初架构／设计目标：改善性能、安全、支持新用户／应用／设备或新能力等。

legacyEntries.en: Political, administrative, or financial influences on the project. Their details may not yet be known.
legacyEntries.zh: 外部影响；政治、行政、财务因素，起初可能尚不明确。

legacyEntries.en: Limits that affect design choices. Some can be removed; others must be worked with.
legacyEntries.zh: 约束；影响设计选择的限制，有些可解除，有些需接受并处理。

legacyEntries.en: Limits on money available. The solution must fit these limits.
legacyEntries.zh: 资金限制；方案必须符合预算，不是可选条件。

legacyEntries.en: Limits related to whom you work with and how groups work together.
legacyEntries.zh: 组织约束：合作对象与各组之间的互动方式。

legacyEntries.en: Limits caused by the wishes or interests of users, managers, or staff.
legacyEntries.zh: 政治性约束：用户、管理层或员工的意愿和利益。

legacyEntries.en: Parts already in the system that may limit a new design.
legacyEntries.zh: 现有部件；可能成为新设计的约束。

legacyEntries.en: Users' tendency to keep the current way of working and resist change.
legacyEntries.zh: 用户惯性；倾向保留已有工作方式，可能约束设计。

legacyEntries.en: Software changed for a particular user's or organisation's needs.
legacyEntries.zh: 定制软件；可能限制新技术的选择。基础词义。

legacyEntries.en: What customers believe the problem and the result should be. Check and realign these when needed.
legacyEntries.zh: 客户预期；需核对问题定义及预期结果，必要时调整不现实预期。

legacyEntries.en: Ways of gathering user information: questions, individual follow-up talks, and group discussion using a whiteboard.
legacyEntries.term: Surveys / one-on-one follow ups / whiteboard sessions
legacyEntries.zh: 问卷、逐人后续访谈、白板讨论；还有面对面会议和与用户相处交流。需权衡耗时。

legacyEntries.en: Warning signs that requirements lack clear, precise meaning.
legacyEntries.zh: 需求警示信号：滥用 real-time、仅给可用率百分比、无验证的 high-performance、反复不一致或不现实要求。

legacyEntries.en: A label listed as a warning when misused and as an indicator of special performance needs. No exact time limit is defined here.
legacyEntries.zh: 实时；课件未给统一时限。需具体说明可测指标与条件，不能仅靠该标签。

legacyEntries.en: A label for higher performance needs. Verify the need and define measurable targets.
legacyEntries.zh: 高性能；必须验证需要并明确指标，不能仅接受标签。

legacyEntries.en: The performance levels the new network is expected to meet.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 性能目标；可能需要先测量才能确定。

legacyEntries.en: Performance needs form separate groups, with a clear threshold between lower and higher needs.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 多层性能；高低性能需求之间有明确分界。

legacyEntries.en: Performance needs do not form a distinct higher group; there is no clear threshold.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 单层性能；没有独特的高性能组，没有明确分界。

legacyEntries.en: A boundary used to separate performance groups.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 性能阈值；图19标为 Performance Threshold。分组依据要有意义。

legacyEntries.en: The highest performance level measured for applications or devices; it helps assess degradation and future capacity needs.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 应用／设备峰值性能；测量结果帮助判断当前性能下降及新网络容量需求。

legacyEntries.en: A fall in performance or quality.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 性能下降／退化。

legacyEntries.en: A network used to study how new technology and the organisation's applications work together.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 试验网络；用于检查新技术与组织应用的互动。

legacyEntries.en: The network already in use; measurements can model behaviour and check reported performance problems.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 现有网络；可用于行为建模及验证已有性能问题。

legacyEntries.en: Keeping requirements current and accessible, while recording changes.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 需求追踪／管理：保持最新、让相关人员可访问、保留变更。

legacyEntries.en: Keep edits in the original paragraph and show additions, deletions, and modifications, including attempts later rejected.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 段落形式／修订追踪；在原段落保留增删改，能看到尝试后被拒绝的变更。

legacyEntries.en: Keep the original requirements in a table and add their changes to it.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 表格形式／电子表格；保留原需求并记录变更。

legacyEntries.en: Named examples of online tools for managing requirements. Their detailed functions are not defined in the PDF.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 课件列出的在线需求管理工具名；不补充产品功能。

legacyEntries.en: An organised record of initial conditions and gathered or derived requirements.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 需求规格说明；示例含初始条件及需求清单，记录来源、状态等。

legacyEntries.en: Template fields for what the project aims to do and how the current problem is described and assessed.
legacyEntries.term: Project goals / problem evaluation and definition
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 模板字段：项目目标／问题评估与定义；区分目标和现有问题描述。

legacyEntries.en: Gathered information comes from a source; derived information is worked out from other information.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 收集得到／推导得到；基础词义，用于需求来源字段。

legacyEntries.en: Fields that identify a requirement, its date, its category, and what it says.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 需求表字段：标识／名称、日期、类型、描述。

legacyEntries.en: Fields recording where a requirement applies, its current state, and its importance.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 需求表字段：位置、状态、优先级。

legacyEntries.en: Not decided yet. It marks information that still needs to be found or agreed.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 待确定；早期可保留，但需明确尚未落实，不猜填。

legacyEntries.en: Technology names in the upgrade example. The supplied material does not define them or give their speeds.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 升级示例中的技术名；课件没有定义或列速度，不自行补充。

legacyEntries.en: A user's computer mentioned in the network upgrade example. No special technical definition is given.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 工作站；示例中为用户计算机，未给专门技术定义。

legacyEntries.en: A named part of the network to which building areas must connect. Its structure is not defined here.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 骨干网；需求表要求各区域连接它，未说明具体结构。

legacyEntries.en: Application categories listed as mission-critical in this company's example; more information is needed.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 数据库、可视化、制造、工资处理应用；该公司示例认定为关键任务应用，表中仍注明需要更多信息。

legacyEntries.en: The example payroll requirement asks for uninterrupted availability during operation between Finance and the outside payroll company.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 运行期间100%正常可用；仅指示例工资应用在财务部门与外部工资公司之间运行时的条件。

legacyEntries.en: Measurements used to check promised service and distinguish performance levels.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 服务指标；用于验证包括外部供应商的网络是否兑现承诺，并区分性能等级。

legacyEntries.en: Counts of bytes or IP packets entering and leaving network devices.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 进出字节数／IP数据包数；可描述设备中的测量变量。

legacyEntries.en: ICMP packets that are not delivered; listed as a service measurement variable.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 被丢弃的ICMP包；课件列为服务测量变量，未定义ICMP协议全称或机制。

legacyEntries.en: A named set of service metrics. SLA is not expanded or defined in the supplied material.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: SLA指标；本周资料未展开缩写或正式定义，不补充合约内容。

legacyEntries.en: Limits on capacity and the amount of short, heavy traffic that can be handled; listed service variables.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 容量上限／突发容忍度；基础词义，课件未给容忍度公式。

legacyEntries.en: A performance measure described here through data rates, data sizes, and bursts.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 容量；本周用数据率、数据量、突发量及持续时间等描述。

legacyEntries.en: The highest data rate needed or measured.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 峰值数据率；最高需求或测量值。

legacyEntries.en: The data rate that continues over time.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 持续数据率；随时间持续保持的数据率。

legacyEntries.en: The lowest data rate needed for acceptable operation.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 最低数据率；可接受运行所需的最低水平。

legacyEntries.en: The amount of data, the amount sent in a burst, and how long that burst lasts.
legacyEntries.term: Data size / burst size / burst duration
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 数据量／突发数据量／突发持续时间；不能只看平均数据率。

legacyEntries.en: The time taken to go from the source to the destination.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 端到端时延；从源到目的地的时间。

legacyEntries.en: The time for traffic to go out and return.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 往返时延；包括返回路径，与单向时延不同。

legacyEntries.en: A general term for delay in this lecture.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 时延／延迟；本讲作为一般延迟用语。

legacyEntries.en: Changes in delay; important for voice, video, and time-sensitive traffic.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 时延变化／抖动；语音、视频及时敏流量需要关注。

legacyEntries.en: Named sources of network measurements; MIB is expanded, but their internal operation is not defined.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 管理协议／管理信息库；资料提到可用于测量，未解释内部机制。

legacyEntries.en: A named tool that can measure delay and packet loss. This expansion is the spelling given on the slide.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 可测时延与丢包的工具；全称按课件保留，不将其认定为已核实的标准名称。

legacyEntries.en: The PDF says it combines delay, per-link capacity measurements, and path traces. The TXT discusses paths and delay; the capacity claim is not confirmed.
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 路由追踪；课件含逐链路容量测量说法，TXT只补充路径与时延。容量能力待核实。

legacyEntries.en: Packets not delivered, a record of the path followed, and capacity for each link. These are measurement expressions.
legacyEntries.term: Packet loss / path trace / per-link capacity
legacyEntries.topic: 性能目标、需求记录与测量
legacyEntries.zh: 丢包／路径追踪／逐链路容量；基础词义，不替课件验证工具能力。

legacyEntries.en: Describe how users and applications use the network. Both spellings appear in the material.
legacyEntries.zh: 描述用户和应用如何使用网络；英式／美式拼写同义。

legacyEntries.en: Three types of behaviour considered in analysis. The PDF names them; it gives detail mainly for users and applications.
legacyEntries.term: User behaviour / application behaviour / network behaviour
legacyEntries.zh: 用户行为／应用行为／网络行为；三类分析对象，PDF主要细化前两者。

legacyEntries.en: Using a representation to predict requirements and flows. It can be a simple approximation or a complex model.
legacyEntries.zh: 仿真／建模；预测需求及数据流，可从简单近似到复杂表示。

legacyEntries.en: How often an application is used and how long a session lasts on average.
legacyEntries.term: Frequency of usage / average length of usage session
legacyEntries.zh: 使用频率／平均会话时长；描述用户行为的两个维度。

legacyEntries.en: Application sessions happening at the same time / periods of application use.
legacyEntries.zh: 并发会话／应用会话；总注册用户数不等于同一时间使用应用的人数。

legacyEntries.en: A practical guide for estimating how performance needs change with use. It is not an exact guarantee.
legacyEntries.zh: 估算性能规模的经验方法；用户行为数据可提供经验依据，不是精确保证。

legacyEntries.en: Graph labels for a session in use, its length, how often it happens, and the time axis.
legacyEntries.zh: 图39标签：活跃、持续时间、频率、时间；同一竖线处可数同时活跃会话。

legacyEntries.en: The highest number of sessions active at the same time. The teacher uses it to explain capacity planning.
legacyEntries.zh: 峰值并发量；教师强调应看同时活跃会话，不只看总使用量。

legacyEntries.en: Features of the traffic an application creates.
legacyEntries.zh: 流量特征；应用行为分析需考虑。

legacyEntries.en: A named application requirement; the PDF does not define multicasting or its mechanism.
legacyEntries.zh: 组播需求；课件列出名称，未解释机制。

legacyEntries.en: Three related performance concerns: failure frequency, time to restore service, and the relationship between them.
legacyEntries.zh: 可靠性、可维护性、可用性；分别关注故障频率、恢复时间及两者关系。

legacyEntries.en: A statistical indicator of how often failure occurs. For complex systems, MTBCF focuses on significant failures.
legacyEntries.zh: 可靠性；故障频率的统计指标。复杂系统中MTBCF更关注重要故障。

legacyEntries.en: The mean time between failures.
legacyEntries.zh: 平均故障间隔时间。

legacyEntries.en: The mean time between failures of mission-critical service; useful for complex systems.
legacyEntries.zh: 平均关键任务故障间隔时间；复杂系统中用于聚焦重要故障。

legacyEntries.en: The rate of failures / take the inverse of their sum. The slide describes this as a way reliability is often calculated, without stating model assumptions.
legacyEntries.zh: 故障率／总和取倒数；课件称常将故障率相加后取倒数，未说明适用模型，不当作所有系统通则。

legacyEntries.en: A statistical measure of the time needed to restore a system to full operation.
legacyEntries.zh: 可维护性；恢复系统完全运行状态所需时间的统计衡量。

legacyEntries.en: The mean time needed for repair. Repair time may include finding the fault, obtaining parts, replacement, testing, and service restoration.
legacyEntries.zh: 平均修复时间；可包含故障发现与隔离、零件送达、更换、测试和恢复服务。TXT的MTDR等疑似转写错误以PDF为准。

legacyEntries.en: Find a failure and locate or separate its cause as part of repair.
legacyEntries.term: Detection and isolation of the failure
legacyEntries.zh: 故障检测与隔离；修复时间中的步骤，资料未进一步定义隔离方法。

legacyEntries.en: Change a faulty part / bring the service back into operation.
legacyEntries.term: Replacement of component / restoration of service
legacyEntries.zh: 部件更换／服务恢复；并非换完部件就完成全部修复。

legacyEntries.en: The relationship between time between failures and repair time: A = MTBCF/(MTBCF+MTTR), or MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR). Scheduled maintenance is excluded here.
legacyEntries.zh: RMA可用性公式；按课件不含计划维护，不必然等于全部日历时间的运行百分比。两种公式的选用需看故障口径。

legacyEntries.en: Planned maintenance. The slide excludes it from its availability formula and says it can occur when critical functions are not needed.
legacyEntries.zh: 计划维护；课件公式不计入，可安排于不需关键功能时；预先换易故障部件可改善可靠性。

legacyEntries.en: Time when the system is available to a user, application, or device. Define whether this means connectivity or full application operation.
legacyEntries.zh: 正常可用时间；需说明是基本连接还是完整应用运行，并明确测量周期。

legacyEntries.en: Time when the required service is unavailable. The scope and measurement period must be stated.
legacyEntries.zh: 不可用时间／停机时间；需定义服务、范围和周期，短暂故障也需计入适用口径。

legacyEntries.en: How much unavailable time an uptime target permits during a stated period.
legacyEntries.term: Amount of allowed downtime / allowable downtime
legacyEntries.zh: 允许停机时长；由给定周期的正常可用率目标对应，不代表故障可任意集中发生。

legacyEntries.en: Availability targets shown in the lecture. The table gives about 53 / 5.3 minutes per year and about 1 minute / 6 seconds per week.
legacyEntries.zh: 四个9／五个9；上述为课件近似值，需明确周期与测量点，不能只报百分比。

legacyEntries.en: Brief effects / changing a traffic route / traffic crowding. The slide names rerouting and congestion as examples of brief disruption.
legacyEntries.zh: 短暂现象／重新路由／拥塞；基础词义，课件列为可能持续几秒的短暂中断因素。

legacyEntries.en: Loss of system service / a small interruption. Even a short outage must be counted in overall availability.
legacyEntries.zh: 系统中断／小规模中断；即使应用只停顿几秒，也不能忽略。

legacyEntries.en: Guide ranges for testbed, low-performance, and high-performance systems; not universal boundaries.
legacyEntries.zh: 一般参考阈值；图50的范围是指导，教师强调不是普遍规律。

legacyEntries.en: State the period, measurement points, and method. Measure end-to-end; count loss in any part of the defined system, or explicitly name selected endpoints.
legacyEntries.zh: 可用性测量：何时、何地、如何。课件建议端到端计入系统各部分损失；也可选择特定用户／主机／网络，但须明确范围。

legacyEntries.en: A router's network connection point / a device used by a user; both are measurement points in the example.
legacyEntries.zh: 路由器接口／用户设备；示例99.99%每周在每个路由接口和用户设备测量。基础词义。

legacyEntries.en: The servers' network / their network interface cards. The example measures 99.999% weekly for server-farm access at named points.
legacyEntries.term: Server farm network / server NICs (network interface cards)
legacyEntries.zh: 服务器群网络／服务器网络接口卡；99.999%示例每周在服务器群路由接口和NIC等指定点测量。

legacyEntries.en: Network labels for the user side and server side of an application ping test. LAN is not expanded in the supplied lecture.
legacyEntries.zh: LAN／用户LAN／服务器LAN；课件未展开缩写。示例用应用ping测两端连接，维护停机不适用此要求。

legacyEntries.en: The named test of connection between each user LAN and the server LAN. The slide does not define a full application test procedure.
legacyEntries.zh: 应用ping／连通性；示例用于用户LAN与服务器LAN连接测试，未给完整应用测试流程。

legacyEntries.en: How long a user is willing to wait for a response. The slide suggests aiming for 10–30 seconds; it is not a rule for every task.
legacyEntries.zh: 交互延迟；用户愿等待响应多久。课件建议10–30秒，教师强调取决于任务。

legacyEntries.en: The boundary where users begin to notice delay; approximately 100 ms in the slide.
legacyEntries.zh: 人类感知响应时间阈值；课件约100毫秒。原文INTD < HRT有疑点，见问题记录。

legacyEntries.en: The slide says users do not notice delay when INTD < HRT. Its use of INTD conflicts with the stated 10–30 second aim; clarification is needed.
legacyEntries.zh: 保留原不等式；与同页INTD定义／目标值关系不清，不能无声改为另一符号或当作已核实公式。

legacyEntries.en: A delay that depends on distance and technology. The material does not give a formula.
legacyEntries.zh: 网络传播时延；取决于距离和技术，未给公式。

legacyEntries.en: How an application sends data / how close an estimate needs to be. Both affect data-rate estimates.
legacyEntries.zh: 传输特征／估计准确程度；影响容量估算。

legacyEntries.en: How long application tasks should take. Targets may come from users or from the application.
legacyEntries.zh: 任务完成时间；可能由用户预期或应用规定。

legacyEntries.en: Additional requirements: operational suitability, supportability, and confidence.
legacyEntries.zh: 补充性能要求：操作适合性、支持能力、数据交付可信度。

legacyEntries.en: Whether customers can operate the planned network; it depends on the architecture/design and the quality of human operators.
legacyEntries.zh: 操作适合性；客户是否能操作计划网络，取决于架构／设计及操作人员能力。

legacyEntries.en: What is needed to operate the design and support continued operation at the required performance level.
legacyEntries.zh: 支持能力；不仅关注交付日性能，还关注持续运行。五因素：RMA、人员、程序与文档、工具、备件及维修件。

legacyEntries.en: The people doing the work / preparing their skills / the number and mix of staff.
legacyEntries.zh: 人员队伍／培训／人员配备水平；支持能力因素。

legacyEntries.en: Instructions for system work / documents describing systems, components, and parts, usually supplied by vendors.
legacyEntries.zh: 系统操作程序／技术文档；技术文档通常由厂商提供，描述系统和组件特性及零件。

legacyEntries.en: Documents describing regular work to prevent failures, including reconfiguration during scheduled maintenance.
legacyEntries.zh: 维护文档／预防性维护；说明周期性预防措施及维护时重新配置等流程。

legacyEntries.en: Special procedures to follow when system faults occur so service can be restored quickly.
legacyEntries.zh: 故障应急处理程序；这里casualty不是日常“伤亡者”词义。

legacyEntries.en: Ordinary and special-purpose tools / spare parts and parts needed for repair.
legacyEntries.term: Standard and special tools / spare and repair parts
legacyEntries.zh: 标准／专用工具；备件／维修件；支持能力的两个因素。

legacyEntries.en: A measure of delivering data without unacceptable error or loss. Acceptable rates depend on what the application can tolerate.
legacyEntries.zh: 数据交付可信度；这里不是个人自信。PDF定义句尾残缺，后文与TXT说明需按应用容忍度规定错误／丢失率。

legacyEntries.en: How often errors or losses happen / the rate an application can accept.
legacyEntries.term: Error and loss rates / acceptable error or loss rate
legacyEntries.zh: 错误率／丢失率；可接受程度依应用对错误或数据丢失的容忍度。

legacyEntries.en: Features such as capacity or delay that may help group applications and set thresholds.
legacyEntries.zh: 应用特征；若能成组可设分界，若时延连续分布则阈值可能人为选定。

legacyEntries.en: Two service categories named in the material. They need extra flow support; their full formal definitions are not supplied.
legacyEntries.zh: 可预测性能／保证性能；需要额外流量支持，需写明确指标与条件。本周未给完整正式定义。

legacyEntries.en: A service category contrasted with predictable and guaranteed performance. Week4 does not give a full definition.
legacyEntries.zh: 尽力而为；Week4只用于对比服务类别，不能自行增加保证机制。

legacyEntries.en: Labels for important business function, data-rate-sensitive service, and user interaction. They indicate needs to investigate; no exact limits are defined.
legacyEntries.zh: 关键任务／数据率关键／交互式；为需求提示词，未给统一指标或界限，需进一步量化。

legacyEntries.en: Place requirements on a geographical view, showing where devices and applications are or may be.
legacyEntries.zh: 需求映射／需求地图；把需求放入地理环境，含现有及可能位置。

legacyEntries.en: A view of locations, such as a building, campus, metropolitan area, or wide area.
legacyEntries.zh: 位置图／地理描述；可采用建筑、校园、都市区域或广域尺度。

legacyEntries.en: Device labels in the campus map: servers for storage, servers for computing, and a digital-video device. No detailed architecture is defined.
legacyEntries.term: Storage server / compute servers / digital video
legacyEntries.zh: 校园图标签：存储服务器、计算服务器、数字视频设备；仅基础词义，无进一步架构定义。

legacyEntries.en: Labels for the three campus areas in the example map.
legacyEntries.term: Central Campus LAN / North Campus LAN / South Campus LAN
legacyEntries.zh: 中央／北／南校园LAN；图中地点标签，不代表通用网络分类。

legacyEntries.en: A figure groups items needed for operating and supporting a network; it does not define a detailed management model.
legacyEntries.zh: 运维与支持／运行操作／支持；图57两栏分组，不扩展为额外模型。

legacyEntries.en: Figure labels for managing work, people, and tools.
legacyEntries.zh: 图57标签：管理、人员、工具；基础词义。

legacyEntries.en: Figure labels for items used up, moving items, renting resources, and places or equipment for work.
legacyEntries.zh: 图57标签：消耗品、运输、租赁、设施；基础词义。

legacyEntries.en: Support-column labels for maintenance help, technical documents, storage, supplies, and changes.
legacyEntries.term: Maintenance support / technical documentation / storage / supply support / modifications
legacyEntries.zh: 图57支持栏标签：维护支持、技术文档、存储、供应支持、修改；仅释标签。

legacyEntries.en: Units in the slides: megabits per second, milliseconds, hours, minutes, and seconds. In the downtime table, m means minutes.
legacyEntries.zh: 单位：兆比特每秒、毫秒、小时、分钟、秒；停机表m为分钟，不能与数据率单位混淆。

legacyEntries.en: Be needed / be strongly asked for / meet a stated condition or rule.
legacyEntries.term: be called for / be demanded / comply with
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 被需要／被要求／遵守或满足；requirement定义中的完整表达。

legacyEntries.en: Collect / make clearer or more exact / information supplied by someone.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 收集／细化／提供的意见或信息；input这里不是键盘输入动作。

legacyEntries.en: A starting foundation / the situation now / decisions about architecture.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 基础／当前状态／架构选择。

legacyEntries.en: Put attention and work on the important parts / find the limits.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 集中精力／识别约束。

legacyEntries.en: Not including every possible item / may themselves limit choices.
legacyEntries.term: NOT exhaustive / may also act as constraints
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 并不穷尽全部情况／也可能成为约束；保留NOT及may的力度。

legacyEntries.en: A supplier / problems people believe exist / an ability the system can provide.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 厂商／被认为存在的问题／能力；perceived不等于已验证。

legacyEntries.en: Related to power or interests / organisational administration / money.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 政治或利益相关／行政相关／财务相关。

legacyEntries.en: Stay within money limits / affect or work with each other.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 符合资金约束／相互作用或合作；MUST表示必须。

legacyEntries.en: Adjust expectations to fit the situation / not possible as expected / when needed.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 调整预期／不现实／必要时；不能省去条件。

legacyEntries.en: A later check or talk / chosen groups / balance one benefit against a cost.
legacyEntries.term: follow-up / selected groups / trade off with
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 后续跟进／选定群体／与另一成本权衡；此处需权衡沟通收益与耗时。

legacyEntries.en: Not being exact enough or easy enough to understand.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 缺少精确性和清晰度。

legacyEntries.en: Use wrongly / only / checking that a need is real.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 误用／仅仅／验证是否确有需要。

legacyEntries.en: Changing greatly / not agreeing with other statements or versions.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 变化很大／不一致。

legacyEntries.en: A group clearly different from others / a clear dividing boundary.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 有显著区别的集合／明确分界。

legacyEntries.en: Carry out measurements / a collection of applications / check using evidence.
legacyEntries.term: conduct measurements / suite of applications / validate
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 进行测量／一组应用／用证据验证。

legacyEntries.en: Current / be able to read or use something.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 最新的／可以访问；需求表应让所有相关人员可读。

legacyEntries.en: Things added, removed, or changed / tried but not accepted.
legacyEntries.term: additions, deletions and modifications / attempted and rejected
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 新增、删除、修改／尝试后被拒绝；要保留变更历史。

legacyEntries.en: Happening repeatedly / suggesting / about, rather than exactly.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 反复出现／建议／大约；示例约150人，不是精确上限。

legacyEntries.en: While working / be judged to be / further information is required.
legacyEntries.term: in operation / be considered / more information needed
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 运行期间／被认为／需要更多信息；需求表中的条件和未决信息。

legacyEntries.en: Tell categories apart / provide the service that was promised.
legacyEntries.term: distinguish between / deliver what it promised
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 区分／兑现承诺；deliver此处指提供服务。

legacyEntries.en: Using these measures / as well as / brings these things together.
legacyEntries.term: in terms of / in addition to / combines ... with ...
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 以……衡量／除……以外还／把……与……结合。

legacyEntries.en: Very simple models that leave detail out / models with more detail.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 简化近似／复杂表示；不把近似当精确事实。

legacyEntries.en: A measure based on statistics / important failures / return to full working condition.
legacyEntries.term: statistical indicator / significant failures / restore to full operational status
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 统计指标／重要故障／恢复完全运行状态。

legacyEntries.en: Does not always show / often have failures.
legacyEntries.term: does not necessarily reflect / tend to fail frequently
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 不必然反映／往往频繁故障；保留not necessarily，不改成绝对否定。

legacyEntries.en: Measured each week, month, or year / have meanings between two ends.
legacyEntries.term: on a weekly/monthly/yearly basis / range from ... to ...
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 按周／月／年／从……到……范围；测量周期与available的具体含义都要说明。

legacyEntries.en: Rise very fast / accept without unacceptable harm / before the event.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 猛增／容忍／提前；提高可用性成本可快速增长。

legacyEntries.en: Short in time / stop making progress / be included in the calculation or assessment.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 短暂／停顿／被计入；应用短停顿也需计入。

legacyEntries.en: Say clearly / for chosen parts / specific / deal with.
legacyEntries.term: explicitly state / selectively / particular / cope with
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 明确说明／有选择地／特定的／应对；测量范围及长短中断不能含糊。

legacyEntries.en: Do not cover / be ready to accept / notice a delay.
legacyEntries.term: do NOT apply to / be willing to / perceive delay
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 不适用于／愿意／感知延迟；例52排除计划维护停机。

legacyEntries.en: Must be considered / have this as the basis.
legacyEntries.term: consideration must be given to / be based upon
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 必须考虑／基于；容量估算有依据与条件。

legacyEntries.en: Extra / affected by / keeping the system working over time.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 补充的／由……影响／持续运行。

legacyEntries.en: Regular / intended to prevent problems / changing a configuration / not normal / without avoidable delay.
legacyEntries.term: periodic / preventative / reconfiguring / abnormal / as soon as possible
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 周期性的／预防性的／重新配置／异常的／尽快。

legacyEntries.en: Chosen without a natural dividing point / values without a clear gap / recognised or labelled as.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 人为选定／连续范围／被识别为；阈值不一定是数据自然形成的。

legacyEntries.en: May be expected at a place / related to locations / related to a city area / covering a large area.
